description: This file defines a MapStruct mapper interface for converting between DelinquencyPausePeriod Java objects and their Avro serialized representation (DelinquencyPausePeriodV1). It is used for serialization/deserialization in loan delinquency pause period processing within the Fineract system.

classes.name: LoanDelinquencyPausePeriodMapper
classes.description: A MapStruct mapper interface for converting between DelinquencyPausePeriod objects and their Avro V1 representation.

methods.name: map
methods.description: Maps a DelinquencyPausePeriod object to its Avro DelinquencyPausePeriodV1 representation.
